levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن بزيع

notes: «- يعني ابن المفضل -» is an editor's gloss, left out
«رأيت مروان ... فحدثنا أن زيد بن ثابت حدثه» : Sahl sat with Marwan, who narrated; Marwan's source is Zayd (rule 5), and Zayd relates the revelation, so he is the last link
The compiler's remark on عبد الرحمن بن إسحاق and his transmitters is not part of the chain, and is not written
